pageCache.text:
Committed to developing the unique qualities of each child
Welcome from Mrs Bucknell - Headteacher
It is my pleasure and privilege to welcome you to Robert Sandilands Primary School and Nursery. At Robert Sandilands, we are proud of the warm, caring and friendly atmosphere within the school. We believe children aren’t numbers or data sets; they are individuals who we want to feel safe, to be happy and well rounded, and who are encouraged to realise their full potential.
The staff will do everything they can to provide the best possible education by developing the unique qualities of your child. Your support is vital. Working together, we provide a community where the children engage and excel.

pageCache.text:
Late/Absence Procedures
Punctuality is really important. The first few minutes of the school day set the tone for the day.
Our school starts at 8.50am. Gates are opened at 8.40am and closed promptly at 8.50am to ensure children's safety. If you arrive after 8.50am, you should bring your child to the school office.
If your child is absent, it is really important to let the school know each day that they are away. Please phone or email the school to let us know the reason:
School Office details: 01635 40318 and office@sandilands.w-berks.sch.uk

pageCache.pageTitle: Robert Sandilands Primary School and Nursery - School Clubs
pageCache.text:
School Clubs
We believe it’s vital that young people get easy access to sports and creative activities outside the classroom and develop new skills and hobbies.
Across the year, we try to offer a range of clubs for all age groups. Some clubs run for a period of weeks, some for a short term, some for a long term and some all year. Staff run many of the clubs, but some are also offered by external providers.
Clubs have included: Computing, Multi-skill Sports, Croquet, Netball, TTRS, Lunchtime Girls and Boys Football, After school Football, Choir, Gymnastics, Cooking, Sewing, Dance, Archery, Gardening, Arts&Crafts, Lego, French Singing and Wide Awake Running.

pageCache.text:
Friends of Robert Sandilands (FORS)
Friends of Robert Sandilands (FORS) is the Parent Teacher Association (PTA) for our school, formed in March 2003. We are a registered charity providing financial help for the school by arranging social events and opportunities for the children to try new things.
All Robert Sandilands parents, staff and governors are automatically members of FORS. Each academic year a committee is elected by the members who attend the Annual General Meeting (AGM) held each September.
Committee planning meetings are then usually held once a half term from 7:00pm at school. All parents are very welcome to attend these meetings.
We always appreciate your ideas and anything you can offer FORS as we are always looking for fresh inspiration.
We provide information regularly via the school’s weekly newsletter and through the school message system, as well as the notice board in the infant playground, which will keep you updated on our activities and meeting dates.
The best way to contact FORS is to send an email to:
forsrobertsandilands@gmail.com
Our Committee
Chair - Clare Stacey
Vice-Chair - Becky Scoon and Asa Oldring
Treasurer - Jaimee Kale
Secreatary - Emily Buckmaster
School Representative - Mrs Franks
Charmaine Butterworth
Fundraising Events
Each year we hold regular events to raise funds, have family fun and help to build the school community!
Some of our annual activities include:
We are always looking for fresh ideas so why not make a suggestion to us for an event?
Every event and every penny raised is thanks to the hard work and commitment of the parents, guardians, staff and students involved with FORS.
As a member, YOU can have a say on how these funds are spent. Every member gets a vote on each request made for funding during our meetings.
Autumn Disco
Christmas Event
Spring Disco
Cake Sales and Uniform Sales
Easter Event
Summer Party
West Berkshire Lottery
FORS have joined the new West Berkshire Lottery.
From every £1 sold, 50p goes directly to the chosen cause and another 10p is put into a community fund. This fund will allow one-off grants to be made to the lottery causes in addition to their direct fundraising and will be awarded by an independent panel on behalf of West Berkshire Council.
The weekly draws take place every Saturday with players able to win a jackpot of up to £25,000 for a matching sequence of six numbers. Other prizes are £2,000, £250, £25 or three free tickets.
Go to https://www.westberkshirelottery.co.uk to find out more and buy tickets.

Wrap Around Care
Pegasus Breakfast & Afterschool Club
Robert Sandilands Primary School and Nursery are very proud to offer parents and pupils our Pegasus Club. Pegasus provides before and afterschool care for our children from Reception to Year 6. It is open from 7.45am to 8.40am and 3.20pm to 6.00pm every school day.
Pegasus Club is run by Mrs Ward (Club Leader) Mrs Major & Mrs Hawkins. They do a great job of providing activities for our children. As well as the fantastic indoor facilities that Pegasus has, they also have access to the KS2 playground.
Here are just a few activities that are available:
Riding bikes/scooters
Growing and picking our own produce
Learning cooking skills
Toys and jigsaws to play with
Lots of dressing up!
Homework support
Arts and Crafts
Learn to knit
Pegasus Menu
Our team do a great job of providing the children with a varied menu through the school year.
How To Book A Place At Pegasus
If you would like to make a booking please visit My Child At School App (MCAS). On the Home Page, select Pegasus and you can then choose either Breakfast Club or After School Club. From there select your date.
For more information about Pegasus, please click on the Parents' Guide below or email our Club Leader, Mrs Ward, at Pegasus@sandilands.w-berks.sch.uk

pageCache.pageTitle: Robert Sandilands Primary School and Nursery - Our School Day
pageCache.text:
Our School Day
For all classes except the Nursery, our school day is from 8.45am - 3.20pm. With registration taken at 8.50am.
The school gates open at 8.40am and the classroom doors at 8.45am.
In the Nursery, the day begins at 9am and ends at 12pm.
Morning Break
The children in Year 1 to Year 6 have a morning break at 10.40. Children may bring in a healthy snack to eat during break.
All children take their break outside, unless its raining and wet play indoors is put in place.
Lunchtime
Lunch starts at 12.00 or 12.10. Our lunchtime controllers supervise lunchtime, on a rota timetable.
EYFS all eat together in the school hall. The rest of the school eat their school meals in the hall, and children with a packed lunch eat in the allocated classrooms with lunchtime controller supervision.
End of The Day
The school day ends at 3.20pm.
Reception to Year 4 staff release the children to a known adult.
Year 5 and 6 are released from their class. To walk home from school, parents/carers have to give permission to the school. We only allow this in year 6.
School Assemblies
We hold school assembly and singing assembly during the week. These are held at 9.05am.
Throughout the year we hold class assemblies and these start at 9.05am. Dates are provided in our newsletter and calendar.
Wrap Around Care
The school runs an in house wrap around care; Pegasus Club. The Breakfast Club runs from 7.45am and the After School Club until 6pm. Find out more here.
In a typical week, we provide 15 hours for Nursery and 32.5 hours for all other classes.

pageCache.pageTitle: Robert Sandilands Primary School and Nursery - Attendance
pageCache.text:
Attendance
At Robert Sandilands we believe that there is a very strong link between school attendance and achievement - our children can only learn effectively if they attend school on time and every day.
We hope our children develop good habits of attendance from the beginning of their time in school. It is vital that we work together closely with our parents to ensure that our children do not miss key learning due to lateness and non- essential absences.
If children are absent for 10% or more of a school year, they are classed as a persistent absentee. 10% of a school year is 19 days or 38 sessions. Children that miss 10% of their time in school will miss over 1 year of schooling throughout their education.
Absence Procedure
We appreciate that there will be times when your child’s absence is unavoidable, such as if they are unwell or they have an urgent medical appointment. If there is a valid reason, the absence will be authorised.
If your child is unable to attend school you must:
Contact the school office on 01635 40318 before 8.50am and leave a message.
Inform us of any prolonged absence, providing copies of medical evidence.
Advise us in advance of any absence that you know will occur in the near future, for example, unavoidable medical appointments. Please provide copies of appointment letters.
We ask that our parents endeavour to make any medical appointments outside of school hours.
Call you, if we haven't heard from you.
Invite you to school to discuss the situation if the absence persists.
Provide support via our pastoral manager or an educational welfare officer to families who have difficulty maintaining good levels of attendance.
Ensure that you have an accurate record of your child's attendance.
If there is not a valid reason for your child’s absence this will be recorded as unauthorised.
Holidays and Planned Absence
School holiday dates are published well in advance and we encourage parents to check the term dates when booking holidays to ensure that these fall within the school holiday dates. Holidays taken in term time can not be authorised.
If parents feel that there are exceptional circumstances to taking their child out of school during term time, an application in writing, must be made to the Head Teacher in advance. The Head Teacher will decide on an individual basis whether or not to authorise the absence.

pageCache.pageTitle: Robert Sandilands Primary School and Nursery - Birthdays
pageCache.text:
Celebrating Birthdays
In the past, families have been kind enough to share sweets or other treats in celebration of their child’s birthday. We would love to continue celebrating birthdays, but with the rise in different dietary requirements, and to foster a healthy lifestyle, we are changing our practice. From now on, we would ask you to share a new book with the class instead. Any sweets or treats sent in will be returned to you with thanks. The children love books and stories and love reading together – what better than sharing a book donated for someone’s birthday?
You can choose any age appropriate book you like. This can be a new release that you may have seen in any shop or online, or a classic that you have enjoyed reading at home or when you were young - anything goes.
If you would like some suggestions, 'Books for Topics' have put together lists of 50 recommended books for children of different ages that may help you. The booklists include both fiction and non-fiction recommendations aimed at developing children’s vocabulary, comprehension skills and creativity. The linked pages are for information purposes and books can be purchased from anywhere you choose.

pageCache.text:
Parent APP - My Child At School (MCAS)
This is our parent communication and payment portal. It is available via a web browser and in the form of an App on both Android and Apple devices. We use this system to provide you with essential information and regular updates about your child(ren) and their life at Robert Sandilands.
Please find below a link to the login page.
New Users of MCAS
You can access My Child at School by going to:
1 - https://www.mychildatschool.com/MCAS/MCSParentLogin
2 – Click on the SIGN UP button
3 – Use the school post code RG14 1TS or school ID 15926
4 – Enter the email address that we have in school for you
5 – You will then be sent a one-time verification code which you can enter in the box and click verify
6 – You will then be asked to create a password. After this you will receive an email confirming that your account has been created
7 – Log back into MCAS either through the website address above or by downloading the My Child at School app from the app store. (Please ensure you enable PUSH notifications as you will not receive communications from the school without it turned on).
Once you have activated your account please check that all the information is correct. Parental consents and data collection information will need to be completed for all children.
Using the Mobile App
You can download the MCAS app via the Apple AppStore or Google Play Store.
Search for MyChildAtScool – Parent App (which will be listed from the publisher Bromcom Computers PLC).
1. You will be asked to choose and confirm a 5 digit pin. This will be used to login to the app. You will also have the option to turn on biometric authentication on the next screen.
2. Enter your e-mail address that the school has on record for you, followed by your password.
3. If you have not set a password yet, please click "Reset Password" to receive a reset link.
Accessing MCAS from a Web Browser
1. Please visit https://www.mychildatschool.com/MCAS/MCSParentLogin
2. Enter your e-mail address that the school has on record for you, followed by your password.
3. If you have not set a password yet, please click "Reset Password" to receive a reset link.
Adding a Sibling Account to MCAS
Some of our parents/carers will already have an MCAS account if they have children already at Robert Sandilands, or at another school who also use MCAS. If this is the case, you can add your child(ren) to your existing account.
1. Login to your existing MCAS app or use the online browser
2. Click on the Accounts button at the top of the app
3. Click the Add New Account button at the bottom
4. Login using your Robert Sandilands account using the School ID (15926) and your new account email and password
5. Your child should then appear on the app
6. To switch between your children you select the account button at the top.
How to Pay for Events or Items on MCAS
1. Select Store at the bottom of the app
2. Select the item you wish to purchase and click add to basket (you can tap the item to view more information)
3. A red dot will appear on the basket icon in the corner
4. If you want to purchase more items, repeat the process.
5. Once everything you require is in your basket, click on the basket.
6. Click on checkout
* If you have already added a card/address skip the next steps
7. Tap the plus sign
8. Enter your address details and tick the save information option
10. Enter your card details in the necessary boxes and tap Make Payment
You will receive an email confirmation of the transaction
MCAS Parent Guide
Please find below the link to the full Bromcom guide to MCAS:
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the Web Address for MCAS?
This link will take you to the MCAS Page:
https://www.mychildatschool.com/MCAS/MCSParentLogin
I've forgotten my e-mail
If you would like to confirm the e-mail address that the school has on record for you, please contact office@sandilands.w-berks.sch.uk
I've forgotten my password
Visit this site to reset your password.
https://www.mychildatschool.com/MCAS/MCSForgottenLogin
Why does the page shake when signing up?
Your password might not match the requirements. Please make sure that the password you are entering is at least 8 characters long and includes, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers and special characters.
How do I change details on MCAS?
Using the Data Collection Form on MCAS you can edit, delete and add selected details of our children's and your personal details.
Some details such as Legal Name cannot be changed on MCAS. Please email the school in the first instance, and if we need further details such as supporting documents, we will let you know.
Any amendments will first be approved by Robert Sandilands School administration staff before any records are permanently updated. Amendments that are not approved will revert back to their original state. There may be a delay in approval, and we may contact you if we need clarification on details.
Give Parental Consent on MCAS
Using the Parental Consent form you can review and grant consents for your child, data, services and images. If you wish to revoke consent, you must email us.
What if I have more than one child attending Robert Sandilands School?
If you have more than one child at the school, you are able to click on the name of the student next to their photograph and it will give you the option to select other students associated with the user. Click on the photograph or the text to change the views allowing information to be viewed with just one login.

School Journey
During the summer term our year six class have the opportunity to go on a school residential trip. This gives the children a chance to build their confidence and have new experiences. It is often the first time our children have been away from home on their own and it can give them some independence.
The trip is beneficial to our children, both educationally and socially and we have seen many children flourish during the experience.
In recent years we've visited the Isle of Wight and here are a few examples of what is on the itinerary:
We like to give our parents as much notice as possible to plan for the residential trip and we offer payment plans to spread the cost.
Our 2026/2027 year six class are going to the Isle of Wight on 24th May - 28th May 2027
